# Key Stash Manager

> A local-first, client-side encrypted credentials manager with live API spend monitoring.

## Overview
Key Stash Manager provides visual environment variable and secrets management directly on the client with zero cloud setup. Built with Web Crypto AES-GCM 256-bit encryption and IndexedDB/OPFS storage.

## Features
- **Local-First Security:** Encrypted at rest using the browser Web Crypto API.
- **Visual Canvas & Profiles:** Group secrets by environments (dev, staging, prod) and project profiles.
- **API Spend Monitoring:** Live balance and spend polling for OpenAI, Anthropic, and OpenRouter.
- **Encrypted Sharing:** Export keys into client-encrypted payloads with ephemeral verification tokens.
